description: Map any CSS color string into the sRGB gamut via perceptual OKLCH chroma reduction. Returns the nearest in-gamut hex, raw OKLCH components, and a `clamped` flag indicating whether the input was out-of-gamut.

input.description: Any CSS color string, e.g. "#ff0000", "oklch(0.6 0.4 30)" (max 256 chars)

name: gamut_map

clamped.description: true when input was out-of-sRGB-gamut and was mapped

oklch.description: Raw (pre-rounding) OKLCH components of the mapped result
